introduction.text: New Horizons photographed Arrokoth during its 2019 flyby. The opening view shows the spacecraft-derived albedo model on the imaged hemisphere. The unseen northern surface is modeled.

albedo.title: New Horizons LORRI albedo model
albedo.summary: Fitted from 30 New Horizons approach observations on 31 December 2018 and 1 January 2019. Grayscale shows the released albedo values. Uniform areas are unconstrained model fill; the archive supplies no coverage mask. This is a fitted surface model, not a global photograph.

model.title: Published New Horizons shape
model.summary: Released New Horizons contact-binary shape: two overlapping closed lobe meshes. Southern surface detail is constrained by flyby imagery; the unseen side is a source model estimate. Revised pole from the bundled Porter paper Table 2. Its PDS XML gives an inconsistent earlier pole; the paper pole is used with arbitrary meridian and no precision spin-phase claim. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
